Global (All).title: Global Food Prices Rise Amid Crop Failures in the Americas and Africa
Global (All).summary: Recent crop failures in the Americas and parts of Africa have driven up global food prices, increasing the risk of social unrest and protests.

Global (All).title: Global Cybersecurity Threats on the Rise as Attacks Increase by 50% in the Past Week
Global (All).summary: Global cybersecurity threats have increased by 50% in the past week, putting businesses and individuals at risk of data breaches and identity theft.

Global (All).title: Global Economic Tensions Rise as US-China Trade War Escalates
Global (All).summary: The US-China trade war has escalated, increasing economic tensions between the two nations and raising concerns about a global economic downturn.

United States.title: US Supreme Court overturns Roe v. Wade
United States.summary: The US Supreme Court's decision to overturn Roe v. Wade, a 1973 ruling that legalized abortion nationwide, has sparked widespread protests and fears of a rollback of women's rights.

United States.title: US-Iran tensions escalate after Israeli drone attack
United States.summary: The US has imposed new sanctions on Iran after an Israeli drone attack on Iranian targets, raising concerns about the escalating tensions between the two countries.

United States.title: US COVID-19 cases surge due to Delta variant
United States.summary: The US has seen a significant increase in COVID-19 cases due to the highly contagious Delta variant, leading to concerns about the country's public health infrastructure and economic recovery.

South Korea.title: South Korean Navy Officer Arrested for Spying for China
South Korea.summary: A South Korean navy officer has been arrested for allegedly spying for China, in a rare case that has sparked concerns about national security.

South Korea.title: Tension Rises Between South Korea and China Over Military Drills
South Korea.summary: Tension has risen between South Korea and China over a joint military exercise between Seoul and Washington, which Beijing has criticized as an attempt to encircle China.

South Korea.title: South Korean President Slammed for Failing to Protect Citizens Amid Protests
South Korea.summary: South Korea's President has faced criticism for her government's inability to protect citizens during recent protests, highlighting the growing concerns about public safety and trust in the government.
